description: AGSC-04-09: where no git history exists — the drop-in flow runs before git init — the build instant defaults to 0, 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, with the warning AGSC-E606, so the instant is always defined. The case is the minimal fixture run by build with no SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in a directory that is not a git checkout; its security.txt is authored with an Expires after that instant, so AGSC-06-36 raises nothing. Derivation: AGSC-E606 is a finding about no file, so its file is the empty string (AGSC-09-11); a warning alone leaves the exit 0 (AGSC-09-08); the NOW line of AGSC-06-22 renders the instant as AGSC-04-10 says and the content version of AGSC-04-25 takes branch 4 with no history, 0.0.0+19700101T000000Z; and every sitemap lastmod is the build instant (AGSC-06-19). files_contain maps an emitted route to strings that its bytes contain.
